accounting: All 192 paid observations, selected branch execution costs, and six original proposal-prefix LLM usages are retained. Historical pre-160 offline compute, Python execution and non-provider wall time lack a prefix checkpoint and are not reconstructed. New costs are measured as continuation deltas. The original later three model calls and their evidence are excluded.
scope: Continue the ordinary branch after its eighth local request failed at the provider character limit. The attempted request remains charged and the eight-call local allowance is spent; do not reopen that local loop. Repair only the existing preview of older nested proposal returns and give the two remaining episode calls to the normal parent dispatcher, as reserved in both arms. Retain both new physical trials, all drafts and the original task ceilings. The local endpoint remains provider_failed; this continuation does not turn that failure into a voluntary stop.

resume.assignment_revision: Preserve original assignment in assignment_before.json; use the current production scientific assignment, with opening snapshot labeled historical and current methods/evidence referenced rather than frozen inline.
resume.scope: Resume an interrupted child or return a completed inquiry to the existing task loop, retaining its notebook, events and world. The world-step ceiling is unchanged; any additional model/Python/wall allowance is recorded separately in this protocol; no new scientific message is inserted. The current tool-interface instructions are supplied by the production agent. A normal prior stop is retained in its source result; this explicit continuation is not autonomous reopening.

response_proposal.scope: Host requests an executable proposal; the model chooses all scientific content. Draft writes use the production paid-comparison path. No offline binding, excluded family or target setting is supplied. Budget changes, if requested, are recorded in the extension entries.

python_budget_extension.scope: Additional development allowance; not an unchanged-budget comparison. All previous work remains charged.

inherited_earlier_timeout_note: The preceding request timed out before producing a decision. Retain its charged attempt and all remaining task budgets; increase only the per-request timeout from 180 to 300 seconds. Current proposal assignment IDs now follow the caller without rewriting old answers or events.
